def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("black car")
    storefront_patches = image_patch.find("storefront")
    
    if not car_patches or not storefront_patches:
        return []
    
    near_storefronts = [car for car in car_patches if any(distance(car, sf) < 100 for sf in storefront_patches)]
